code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != 2 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                comp.append((y, x))
                for dy in (-1, 0, 1):
                    for dx in (-1, 0, 1):
                        q = (y + dy, x + dx)
                        if 0 <= q[0] < h and 0 <= q[1] < w and grid[q[0]][q[1]] == 2 and q not in seen:
                            seen.add(q)
                            stack.append(q)
            comps.append(comp)
    centers = [( (min(r for r,c in comp)+max(r for r,c in comp))//2,
                 (min(c for r,c in comp)+max(c for r,c in comp))//2) for comp in comps]
    for i in range(len(comps)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(comps)):
            r1,c1 = centers[i]
            r2,c2 = centers[j]
            if r1 == r2 and c1 != c2:
                left, right = (i,j) if c1 < c2 else (j,i)
                y = r1
                xleft = max(c for r,c in comps[left] if r == y)
                xright = min(c for r,c in comps[right] if r == y)
                for x in range(xleft+1,xright):
                    if out[y][x] == 0: out[y][x] = 1
            elif c1 == c2 and r1 != r2:
                top, bottom = (i,j) if r1 < r2 else (j,i)
                x = c1
                ytop = max(r for r,c in comps[top] if c == x)
                ybottom = min(r for r,c in comps[bottom] if c == x)
                for y in range(ytop+1,ybottom):
                    if out[y][x] == 0: out[y][x] = 1
    return out
'''
